scenarioCampaignPlaced.reason: Mysterious Omens (10160) says "each player may choose 1 of the following boons and attach it to a hero they control: Cunning, Hardy, Resolute, Ruthless, or Stalwart", so the five boons, Cunning, Hardy, Resolute, Ruthless and Stalwart, are dealt with The Weather Hills, though no Setup or Resolution line of the campaign card names them.

Mysterious Omens (10160) stays in the Campaign Pool when it is not defeated in The Weather Hills, and a later scenario's Campaign Setup Checklist shuffles it into the encounter deck. Its Forced offers the five boons ("Cunning, Hardy, Resolute, Ruthless, or Stalwart"), so the printed card of each of the five boons is loaded with every later Angmar Awakened scenario and a copy comes from the supply when a player takes it; a boon the Campaign Pool already holds on a hero is not offered (each has one copy).

The Wastes of Eriador's Campaign Setup adds Determination (10172) to the Campaign Pool and shuffles Fend Off Despair (10173) into its encounter deck, and its Resolution adds Fend Off Despair to the pool. Both stay in the pool, so a later scenario's Campaign Setup Checklist deals them (a player may hold Determination in their deck and Fend Off Despair is shuffled into the encounter deck), and each is played and defeated there as it was here: the printed card of each is loaded with every later Angmar Awakened scenario.

Loot the Dungeons (10175) says "each player ... may choose one of the following boons and add it to their hand: Berelind, Chieftain's Brooch, Coruhaer, Laermuin, Mail of Eärnur, or Silverthorn", so the six boons are dealt with Escape from Mount Gram as set-aside cards, each a single copy, though no Setup or Resolution line of the campaign card names them. A boon a player added to their hand stays in the Campaign Pool, so each later Angmar Awakened scenario deals the printed card of each of the six too.
